title: The Cultural Psychology of Large Language Models: Is ChatGPT a Holistic or Analytic Thinker?

bias_targets.methodology: Administering psychological scales (Analysis-Holism Scale, Dialectical Self Scale, Self-construal Scale) and the Triadic Categorization Task to evaluate whether LLMs exhibit Eastern holistic or Western analytic thinking styles, and comparing the models' responses to established human cultural norms.
